content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online involves more than just uploading your music; it requires a reliable infrastructure that enables smooth transactions. Traditional payment processors often impose geographical restrictions, leaving many creators unable to monetize their work effectively. This is particularly crucial in markets where conventional payment methods are either unavailable or come with exorbitant fees. The significance of adopting a sovereign commerce stack—where you control your assets and avoid high platform fees—cannot be overstated. With NOWPayments integrated into your stack, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing your customers to pay in a currency they prefer while ensuring you retain more of your earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling beats online with crypto payments is designed for resilience and independence. Essentially, your digital store operates on a stack that includes hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. These platforms offer free hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend logic seamlessly. Once a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments handles the cryptocurrency transaction verification with an incredibly low fee, ensuring immediate payment confirmation. This entire process is automated, providing you with instant product delivery, and allowing you to focus on creating rather than managing transactions. This structure is not just efficient; it ensures that you are not dependent on any single platform.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators who refuse to be limited by traditional payment gateways. If you're a beat maker in Nigeria, a course creator in Kenya, or any digital entrepreneur in regions facing payment restrictions, this solution is tailored for you. This architecture empowers you to take control of your sales process, offering you sovereignty over your digital products. Every aspect of this stack is designed to eliminate barriers, allowing you to reach a global audience while maintaining low overhead costs. The focus is clear: provide creators with the tools to succeed without the usual financial constraints imposed by mainstream platforms.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, far less than Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively sell beats online using crypto payments, several components must work in unison. First, you need a reliable hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve this purpose. Next, backend functionality is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, enabling automated delivery of your beats as soon as payment is confirmed. Order storage can be managed using Supabase or Google Sheets, which are both free and scalable solutions. Finally, NOWPayments acts as your payment processor, facilitating transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies without the hassles of KYC or buyer account requirements. Together, these components form a robust and efficient ecosystem that supports your digital sales efforts.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying your digital commerce stack to sell beats online is straightforward. Start by selecting your preferred hosting solution—either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions and automated delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, ensuring you offer your customers multiple payment options. For data storage, use Supabase or Google Sheets to keep track of your sales and customer information securely. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary templates and blueprints to streamline your deployment process, allowing you to launch your digital store efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using alternative payment processors like NOWPayments, which allow for cryptocurrency transactions. This method circumvents the need for traditional platforms, enabling you to retain more of your profits and serve customers globally. By adopting this infrastructure, you can enjoy lower fees and complete control over your sales process.
Complete control over your digital sales process is now possible.

This kit provides you with everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your own digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
